scope: Sol high Tokyo COMPLEX macro 1 for suntory-hall-main only. No existing production venue, other COMPLEX target, recorded hold, or P2 target was reopened.

outcome.firstPass: The current official hall seat map was rendered at high resolution and every printed numbered run was transcribed without fitting to capacity. The result was 1F rows 1-14 510, rows 15-23 348, 1F 858; all ten 2F blocks matched their printed subtotals for 1,148; total 2,006.
outcome.independentSecondPass: A fresh extraction from the separately published current official rental guide seat map re-read every 1F row, every LA/LB/LC/LD/C/RA/RB/RC/RD/P endpoint, and the split runs in 1F row 23 plus C and P. It reproduced 2,006 seats with zero range diff and the same printed floor/block subtotals.
outcome.newOfficialEvidence: The current issuer rental guide requires the Main Hall to be all-reserved and directs ticket issuance from the hall's 2,006-seat map. The issuer seat/facility/barrier-free pages independently state 2,006 total, 1F 858, 2F 1,148, six dedicated unnumbered wheelchair spaces, up to 14 universal-design compatible seats, and a 39-part stage lift.
outcome.variantResolution: The six dedicated wheelchair symbols are outside the numbered runs; up to 14 universal-design compatible seats are an on-request operational conversion; and the 39-part lift is stage equipment, not an alternative audience-seat numbering. These issuer statements make the standard printed 2,006-number seat map a unique representative selectable set without inventing a policy.

summary.nextRecommended: Sol high Tokyo COMPLEX macro 2 for meijiza only; preserve suntory-hall-main and every existing production/hold, and do not start kabukiza, setagaya-public-theatre, or P2 in the same macro.
